# Oxide v0.2.1 - Table of Contents

Elixir NIF bindings for Tailwind CSS Oxide — fast parallel content scanning and candidate extraction.

## Pages

- [Oxide](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Oxide](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/Oxide.md): Elixir bindings for Tailwind CSS Oxide — the Rust-powered content scanner.
- [Oxide.Candidate](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/Oxide.Candidate.md): Extracted candidate with byte position.
- [Oxide.Changed](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/Oxide.Changed.md): Changed content for incremental scanning.
- [Oxide.Glob](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/Oxide.Glob.md): Glob entry returned by the scanner.
- [Oxide.Source](https://oxide-ex.hexdocs.pm/Oxide.Source.md): Source entry for scanner configuration.
